name: Direction set at 10:00, then a VWAP pullback
why: Trend traders add on a pullback to VWAP; with the direction already set, the pullback should be a better price than chasing. Pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_direction_first.md).

scan.when: !rollwin && abs(at(10,0) - open) > 0.25 * atr && ((sign(at(10,0) - open) > 0 && lo(5,1) <= vwap && cl(5,1) > vwap) || (sign(at(10,0) - open) < 0 && hi(5,1) >= vwap && cl(5,1) < vwap))
